# Read data
```{r }
library(tidyverse)
data <- readr::read_csv("SeoulBikeData.csv",
                        locale = locale(encoding = "Latin1"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)
dim(data)
head(data)
```

# EDA

```{r }
# missing 
colSums(is.na(data)) 
# no missinhg data 

# check column type and basic values and range 
str(data)
summary(data)
head(data$Date)

# convert date
library(lubridate)
data$Date <- dmy(data$Date)

# convert variables into factor (Seasons, Holiday, and Functioning Day)
data$Seasons <- factor(data$Seasons)
data$Holiday <- factor(data$Holiday)
data$`Functioning Day` <- factor(data$`Functioning Day`)

# change name easily
data <- data %>%
  rename_with(~ tolower(gsub(" ", "_", .x))) %>%
  rename( temperature = `temperature(°c)`) %>%
  rename( humidity =  `humidity(%)`) %>%
  rename(dew_point_temperature = `dew_point_temperature(°c)`) %>%
    rename(
    bike_count = rented_bike_count,
    rainfall = `rainfall(mm)`,
    snowfall = `snowfall_(cm)`,
    wind_speed = `wind_speed_(m/s)`
  ) 

# summary again
summary(data)

# subset, there is some day functioning is 0? 
data <- data %>%
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes")
#
data <- data %>%
  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bike_count = sum(bike_count),
    total_rainfall = sum(rainfall),
    total_snowfall = sum(snowfall),
    mean_temperature = mean(temperature),
    mean_humidity = mean(humidity),
    mean_wind_speed = mean(wind_speed,),
    mean_dew_point_temperature = mean(dew_point_temperature),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


## strata and split data 
```{r}
library(rsample)
set.seed (2738)
split_data <- rsample::initial_split(
  data,
  prop = .75,
  strata = seasons
)

train_data <- rsample::training(split_data)
test_data <- rsample::testing(split_data)

```
# model
```{r }
### classify weekday or weekend 

train_data <- train_data %>%
  mutate(weekday = factor(ifelse(wday(date, week_start = 1 )>= 6, "Weekends", "Weekday")))

test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(weekday = factor(ifelse(wday(date, week_start = 1 )>= 6, "Weekends", "Weekday")))




### standardization 

numerica_vars <- c("total_bike_count",
    "total_rainfall",
    "total_snowfall",
    "mean_temperature",
    "mean_humidity",
    "mean_wind_speed",
    "mean_dew_point_temperature")

train_mean_num <- sapply(train_data[numerica_vars], mean)
train_sd_num <- sapply(train_data[numerica_vars], sd)

test_mean_num <- sapply(test_data[numerica_vars], mean)
test_sd_num <- sapply(test_data[numerica_vars], sd)

train_data <- train_data %>%
  mutate (
    across(all_of(numerica_vars), ~ (.x-train_mean_num[cur_column()])/train_sd_num[cur_column()])
    ) 

test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate (
    across(all_of(numerica_vars), ~ (.x-test_mean_num[cur_column()])/test_sd_num[cur_column()])
    ) 

## modeling
# A model with all the standardized numeric variables included along with the seasons, holiday, and weekend/weekday variables.

model1 <- lm (total_bike_count ~  total_rainfall + total_snowfall + mean_temperature+ mean_humidity + mean_wind_speed + mean_dew_point_temperature + seasons + holiday + weekday, data = train_data)

# 2. A model with all the terms in the first model but also interactions between seasons and holiday, seasons and temp, and temp and rainfall (all standardized variables used here).

model2 <- lm (total_bike_count ~  total_rainfall + total_snowfall + mean_temperature+ mean_humidity + mean_wind_speed + mean_dew_point_temperature + seasons:holiday + seasons:mean_temperature + mean_temperature:total_rainfall, data = train_data)

            
#3. A model with all the terms in the second model and also squared terms for the temp and humidity variables (standardized versions). Use I() here to create the quadratic terms.
train_data$squared_temp <- I(train_data$mean_temperature)*train_data$mean_temperature
train_data$squared_humi <- I(train_data$mean_humidity)*train_data$mean_humidity
model3 <- lm (total_bike_count ~  total_rainfall + total_snowfall + mean_temperature+ mean_humidity + mean_wind_speed + mean_dew_point_temperature + seasons:holiday + seasons:mean_temperature + mean_temperature:total_rainfall + squared_temp + squared_humi, data = train_data)
```

# predicted value and rmse
```{r}
# fit model1 
test_data$predicted <- predict(model1, newdata = test_data)
rmse_model1 <- sqrt(mean(test_data$total_bike_count - test_data$predicted)^2)  

# fit model2 
test_data$predicted2 <- predict(model2, newdata = test_data)
rmse_model2 <- sqrt(mean(test_data$total_bike_count - test_data$predicted2)^2)  

# generate new variables for test data 
test_data$squared_temp <- I(test_data$mean_temperature)*test_data$mean_temperature
test_data$squared_humi <- I(test_data$mean_humidity)*test_data$mean_humidity

test_data$predicted3 <- predict(model3, newdata = test_data)
rmse_model3 <- sqrt(mean(test_data$total_bike_count - test_data$predicted3)^2)  
```
